title: BPBD/Pusdalops DIBI 2022 source qualification
parallel_gate_note: M52 remains reserved for the still-unrecovered 2017 raw annual-report artifact. M53 is an independent evidence-expansion lane and does not satisfy or bypass M52.
research_question: Can the official BPBD/Pusdalops Data dan Informasi Bencana Sumatera Barat Tahun 2022 publication support the dashboard dimensions we need—district, hazard, impact, loss and month—without promoting search-index or mirror text before the official raw bytes are recovered and hashed?

official_source.title: Buku DIBI Tahun 2022
official_source.producer: Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah Provinsi Sumatera Barat / Pusdalops PB

source_methodology.event_deduplication_rule: kejadian yang sama pada tanggal yang sama dihitung satu kali
source_methodology.detail_accumulation_rule: wilayah administrasi, dampak dan kerugian diakumulasi untuk satu peristiwa
source_methodology.reporting_dependency: volume and completeness depend on Pusdalops input and reports supplied by each kabupaten/kota

source_quality_flags: The legacy official PDF URL is indexed but returned HTTP 404 during the 2026-09-02 review, so raw bytes and checksum remain unavailable.
Table 3.3 indexes no missing-person total while Table 3.4 indexes four missing persons; the disagreement must be preserved until raw-page verification.
Seven district event counts differ between the event tables and the district human-impact table even though both table families total 1,021 events.
Search-index rendering corrupts several monetary cells as link placeholders; only clearly rendered verification targets may be frozen before raw acquisition.
The indexed Scribd copy is not an official artifact and cannot authorize canonical materialization.

acquisition.exit_gate: official raw PDF bytes acquired from an allowlisted government surface and SHA256 frozen

next_actions: Recover the current PPID UUID/download route or another official sumbarprov.go.id copy for the 2022 DIBI PDF.
Freeze exact bytes, SHA256, acquisition timestamp and page count.
Verify Tables 3.1-3.10 and the appendices against the indexed targets while preserving every disagreement.
Materialize separate source-native tables for district-by-hazard events, human impacts, physical impacts, monthly events and recorded losses.
Only after raw verification, add the materialized 2022 BPBD datasets to catalog/public-datasets.csv and use them as dashboard proof data.
